cells.note: Rebuild 2026-11-13: ThinkLab in Maputo took 12 startups in its first cycle (MOZ-004) and the ATDI incubator in Nampula runs a pre-incubation cohort of seven (MOZ-006, July 2026), so hubs with programmes run in two cities: 3 to 4. The science parks have no tenants on record, so not 5.
